offence_note: Sexual exploitation of a young person (sexual assault conditionally stayed)
sentence_quote: I sentence you to a jail term of 90 days, less credit of 1.5 days in respect of the one day that you have already spent in jail, for a total of 88.5 days.
note: Intermittent sentence on weekends; Charter challenge to mandatory minimum also decided.

offence_note: Offence involving call to undercover police officer; not specified
sentence_quote: We find this sentence within the appropriate range.
note: Endorsement; offence and length of sentence under appeal not stated; offender already serving eight-year term.

offence_note: Attempted parental abduction and unlawfully being in a dwelling
sentence_quote: I would reduce the sentence imposed for the attempted abduction from 2 years to 9 months less remand time.
note: Abduction cut to 9 months; 12-month dwelling sentence not under appeal; global total not shown; assault acquitted on appeal; Scanlan J.A. dissented on sentence.

offence_note: Break and enter and sexual assault causing bodily harm on elderly victim
sentence_quote: I will impose a life sentence in relation to this.
note: Life for break and enter, 14 years for sexual assault causing bodily harm; joint recommendation; parole denied ten years.

offence_note: Second degree murder of elderly woman
sentence_quote: Considering the circumstances of this case and the brutal attack on Mrs. Widholm, a parole ineligibility period of 13 years is fit and is proportionate to sentences for similar offenders in similar circumstances

offence_note: Manslaughter by stabbing in Downtown Eastside alleyway
sentence_quote: For the offence of manslaughter against Faisal Mohammed I sentence you to seven and a half years in prison, which is 90 months.
note: Addiction and mental disorder found not particularly mitigating.

offence_note: Four break and enters, shooting victim, aggravated assault, firearm offences
sentence_quote: The total sentence, then, is 14 years. From it, I deduct the effective four years and nine months that the accused has already spent in custody.
note: Global 14 years; net nine years three months after 1,730 days credit.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for the purpose of trafficking (six kilos)
sentence_quote: The sentence of one year is set aside and a sentence of three years is substituted for it.
note: Crown appeal; about four months pre-trial custody, equivalent to 44 months total.

offence_note: Production of marijuana and possession for trafficking
sentence_quote: We accordingly amend the house arrest conditions to run for just the first twelve months of the concurrent conditional sentences.
note: House arrest shortened, electronic monitoring and probation removed; other mitigating: efforts to operate legally.
